name: Computerization of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS)
department: Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India
summary: Centrally sponsored project to digitize 63,000 PACS across India with standard cloud ERP software.
benefits: Direct linkage with NABARD and DCCBs
eligibility_criteria: Registered Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society

name: Tamil Nadu Cooperative Crop Loan Waiver Scheme
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
summary: Waiver of outstanding crop loans for small & marginal farmers holding up to 5 acres.
benefits: Waiver of outstanding principal and interest on short-term crop loans.
eligibility_criteria: Member of registered PACCS in Tamil Nadu
Land holding up to 5.00 acres with valid Patta / Chitta
